identity.description: LiveAgent is a helpdesk and customer support software product from QualityUnit, with ticketing, knowledge base and AI features. Its public API v3 is at YOURDOMAIN.ladesk.com/docs/api/v3/.
identity.identity_notes: Sources describe the product as LiveAgent helpdesk software and tie it to QualityUnit: the official LiveAgent support site, the LiveAgent pricing page, and the QualityUnit-owned GitHub repos. Search results also show third-party listings (Capterra, Software Advice) for the same product.

auth.oauth_flows: For the built-in MCP server, the LiveAgent docs describe OAuth 2.1 with automatic authorization-server discovery and a consent screen. No OAuth flows are documented for the REST API v3 in the sources I read.
auth.token_refresh: unknown. API keys are static and regenerated manually. MCP bearer tokens expire two years after generation, and OAuth 2.1 refresh behavior is not documented in what I read.
auth.scopes_notes: API v3 keys can have permissions defined per key when added. The docs also state that 'Generating a new key immediately disables the old one' (search snippet only). Per-tool MCP access depends on the role or the AI agent's tool selection.

access.production_restrictions: No sandbox was found. A 30-day free trial with no credit card is the documented route to a live test account. API keys are included on all four published plans, with key counts of 1 (Starter), 5 (Team), 10 (Business), and unlimited (Enterprise). Whether API keys are included during the trial, and whether a free developer account exists, is not established.

read_ops: Read operations on agents and tickets are referenced in the docs; the full v3 resource list was not extracted
MCP read tools include search_tickets, get_ticket_metadata, get_ticket_messages, list_agents, list_departments, search_kb_articles, get_kb_article
write_ops: Docs name methods get, post, and delete for v3 (v3 docs page)
MCP write tools include add_note, assign_ticket, transfer_ticket, resolve_ticket, reopen_ticket, create_kb_article, update_kb_article (these are MCP tools, not confirmed v3 REST endpoints)
api.rate_limits: Rate limits exist per the docs ('There are limits related to API and API keys.'). Specific numbers were not extracted; the detail page is https://support.liveagent.com/931802-API-rate-limit-API-requests-limit (not fetched).
api.limitations: The full v3 endpoint list is only in the in-account docs at YOURDOMAIN.ladesk.com/docs/api/v3, which I could not access. Webhooks are not established. The v1 REST reference page returned 404 when fetched.

open_questions: Webhooks: no source found that confirms webhook support in LiveAgent API v3 or on any plan.
Full v3 endpoint list and read/write breadth could not be confirmed. The v3 docs are only available inside a LiveAgent account (YOURDOMAIN.ladesk.com/docs/api/v3).
Whether API keys and the API are available during the 30-day trial, and whether a free developer or sandbox account exists, is not confirmed.
Whether non-admin users can generate API keys (the docs imply admin access but do not say it is restricted).
Rate limit numbers were not extracted (detail page 931802 not fetched).
OAuth 2.1 details for the MCP server (scopes, refresh) are not fully documented in the pages I read.
The qualityunit/liveagent-mcp-server repo's license is conflicting (Apache-2.0 vs MIT). The page for the Python client states no license.
The v1 REST complete API reference (840770 / 528264) returned 404 or was not fetched; v1 is legacy, so v3 is the relevant API.
All quotes came from WebFetch summaries. Verbatim matching against page bytes was not performed, so verified is null for every claim.

assessment.approach: Wrap/benchmark vendor's official MCP server; add managed auth
rationale: Self-serve test credentials (trial self serve) and a documented CLI/library/REST interface.
